blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — As the Premier Volleyball League (PVL) continues to raise its level of competition, Nxled star Brooke Van Sickle continues to rise with it. Van Sickle has backed that up with two solid performances in her return from a shoulder injury, helping Nxled take down contenders PLDT and Farm Fresh for a strong 2-0 start to its 2026 PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series campaign. “I think as PVL continues with its years, I do think that the competition is getting significantly harder.
